_about: AF Hub platform registry. One entry per project database in the shared Firebase project af-hub-8f188. platform/tests/config.test.cjs checks every project folder against this file, so a copied firebase-config.js or project-config.js that still points at another project fails CI before it is deployed.

design._about: The design team's database: every project's Design Board lives in it under /boards/<board>. Not a tracker, so it is kept out of "projects" (no report, no tracker folder checks). Rules: design-database.rules.json. Page: /design/.
design.name: AF Design Boards

hosted._about: A project whose page is NOT the hub tracker engine: someone else's page, hosted in the hub as-is with mn/hub-adapter.js (hub login, its own af-hub database, progress on the overview). Morgan North = Benji's Glass Replacement Tracker; mn/index.html is built from his site by mn/build.mjs (.github/workflows/mn-update.yml).
hosted.name: Morgan North
